How Daily Poster works.

Every morning there's a new poster brief at dailyposter.design, made from a story in the news: three headlines to choose from, the day's colour palette, a typeface pairing, images and 3D renders. Make an A-size poster, tag @dailyposter.design and add the day's number, like #dailyposter034. We share our favourites.
